name: Skin Pathology: Blistering, Papulosquamous Disease and Tumours

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Desmoglein compensation (Dsg3 mucosa, Dsg1 skin) maps blister depth while hemidesmosome BP180 failure tents subepidermal bullae; psoriatic hyperproliferation parakeratoses with neutrophil microabscesses, and BRAF clones descend Breslow depths metastasising.
additionalDifferentials: Pemphigus versus pemphigoid by split and mucosa
Psoriasis versus lichen planus by scale and striae
BCC versus SCC versus melanoma by palisade, pearls and pigment
additionalInvestigations: Punch with direct immunofluorescence in blisters
Dermoscopy with ABCDE mapping in pigmented lesions
Biopsy Breslow with sentinel node in melanoma
